title: sambucus racemosa subsp. miquelii
intro: Sambucus racemosa subsp. miquelii, commonly known as the American elderberry, is a deciduous shrub native to North America, belonging to the Adoxaceae family. The health benefits of American elderberry include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate symptoms of the common cold and flu, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of American elderberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
